correctness.rationale: The 9 monomials of O(2,2) over F2 give 511 distinct nonzero forms. On all projective product charts the partials are univariate degree <=2 in opposite variables; their common geometric roots have coordinates in F4 when both nonzero, or in F16 after solving a quadratic over F4 when one vanishes; the both-zero derivative case is a square and has a small-field zero. Thus the independent exhaustive F16 singular-point test certifies all geometric points, giving exactly 144 smooth forms. A complete XOR-closed-triple enumeration gives 804 two-dimensional pencils and testing every additional vector coset forbids all-smooth nets. The independent evaluation-basis isomorphism F2^9 -> functions on the 3x3 rational grid and full 72-element (S3xS3)rtimes C2 action produce 13 orbits (10*72+2*36+12). For all 13 orbit representatives, independently computed unit Groebner ideals (f,g,f_x g_y+f_y g_x) on four charts prove geometric transversality; by invariance this holds for all 804. Distinct smooth members have no component in common, so (2,2).(2,2)=8 yields exactly eight distinct geometric base points. Independent exact counts of zeros in F_(2^d) for d=1..8 for each representative, using proven fields and Mobius/divisor recovery N_d=sum_{e|d} e c_e, yield precisely cycle spectra (8):72,(2,3,3):12,(1,7):288,(1,2,5):216,(1,1,6):216. The computation is genuinely exhaustive for this finite problem; saved stdout alone was not used as proof.

value.rationale: The line bundle O(2,2) is the smallest positive bidegree with arithmetic genus one on the split quadric; asking for all rational pencil members to be geometrically smooth is a natural finite-field Bertini/existence extremal question, not an arbitrary slice. The complete classification gives an exact maximal pencil dimension, 13 coordinate-stabilizer types and five arithmetic base Frobenius patterns; its irreducible degree-eight base orbit is a distinguished natural extremal configuration. These are exact incidence/arithmetic invariants of a canonical minimal genus-one system, not simply a known elliptic-curve isomorphism count or a tiny normalization check. Finite and self-contained classification is independently useful without a demanded infinite-family theorem.
scope: Split P1xP1 over F2 only, coefficient subspaces modulo its 72-element F2 automorphism group; not abstract genus-one isomorphism classes.
No nonsplit quadric, larger q, other bidegrees, arbitrary extension-field pencils or higher-genus classification.
